mapper.select: SELECT PARA_TYPE, CURRENT_VER_NO, CURRENT_FILE_NAME, VALID_DATE_TIME, MD5_VALUE, LAST_UPD_USER, LAST_UPD_TMS FROM TBL_PARA_VERSION WHERE PARA_TYPE = #{paraType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TBL_PARA_VERSION target USING ( SELECT #{paraType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PARA_TYPE, #{currentVerNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC} CURRENT_VER_NO, #{currentFileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CURRENT_FILE_NAME, #{validDateTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} VALID_DATE_TIME, #{md5Value,jdbcType=VARCHAR} MD5_VALUE, #{lastUpdUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LAST_UPD_USER, #{lastUpdTms,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} LAST_UPD_TMS FROM DUAL ) source ON (target.PARA_TYPE = source.PARA_TYPE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.CURRENT_VER_NO = source.CURRENT_VER_NO, target.CURRENT_FILE_NAME = source.CURRENT_FILE_NAME, target.VALID_DATE_TIME = source.VALID_DATE_TIME, target.MD5_VALUE = source.MD5_VALUE, target.LAST_UPD_USER = source.LAST_UPD_USER, target.LAST_UPD_TMS = source.LAST_UPD_TMS WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PARA_TYPE, CURRENT_VER_NO, CURRENT_FILE_NAME, VALID_DATE_TIME, MD5_VALUE, LAST_UPD_USER, LAST_UPD_TMS ) VALUES ( source.PARA_TYPE, source.CURRENT_VER_NO, source.CURRENT_FILE_NAME, source.VALID_DATE_TIME, source.MD5_VALUE, source.LAST_UPD_USER, source.LAST_UPD_TMS )
